candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis requires three components: (1) mixed mold infection specifying both Rhizopus microsporus and Mucor racemosus, (2) disseminated mucormycosis (not limited to rhino-orbito-cerebral). C001 names only the rhino-orbito-cerebral anatomical subtype, omitting the dual-pathogen etiology confirmed by mNGS and the disseminated scope evidenced by bilateral lung infiltrations. The anatomical designation 'rhino-orbito-cerebral' also conflicts with 'disseminated' as the primary scope descriptor, and orbital/cerebral involvement is not confirmed in the record.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: C001 specifies rhino-orbito-cerebral anatomical pattern and does not capture the mixed dual-pathogen etiology (Rhizopus microsporus + Mucor racemosus) nor the disseminated scope (bilateral lung infiltrations indicating pulmonary/disseminated involvement beyond rhino-orbito-cerebral)

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis specifies disseminated scope based on bilateral lung infiltrations plus sinonasal disease; orbital and cerebral involvement not explicitly confirmed by imaging or pathology
Dual-pathogen mNGS finding (Rhizopus microsporus + Mucor racemosus) is a key distinguishing feature of the reference that no candidate captures
